column1: # Americanist phonetic notation -> IPA (Tier 1 of the IPA conversion strategy).
# Applied by scripts/to_ipa.py to lists classified `americanist`, EXCEPT Czech
# (ces) and Slovak (slk): there the carons are native Slavic ORTHOGRAPHY, not
# Americanist notation, so they are routed to the rule-based Slavic G2P handler
# (scripts/slavic_g2p.py, method `slavic_g2p`) instead of being mis-converted here.
# Only UNAMBIGUOUS, tradition-independent correspondences are listed. Already-IPA
# symbols in these lists (ð ə θ ʔ ɲ ɣ ʎ ʒ ç ʂ ŋ ⁿ and IPA diacritics) are left
# untouched. Tradition-specific symbols are DELIBERATELY not mapped and instead
# reported as `residual` for per-list review:
#   - dot-below ḍ ṇ ṭ ẓ ṣ : retroflex (Indic) vs pharyngealized (Berber) -- context-dependent
#   - j / y               : Americanist j=ʒ/d͡ʒ, y=glide; but some lists contrast j vs ǯ
#   - accent/tone marks á é í ó ú ê ô â, ä ö ü, ˗ : tone/stress/quality, list-specific
#   - stray '\'           : data-corruption artifact (see TODO data-quality notes)
